item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:45 HKT 29/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the southerly airstream affecting the coast of southern China weakening, showers will lessen and the weather will be brighter and very hot over the region in the next couple of days. The southwesterly airstream affecting the South China Sea will become active in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather will be unsettled over the coast of southern China. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Khanun will move across the western North Pacific in the next couple of days, and move in the general direction of the vicinity of the coast of eastern China midweek next week.

Date/Month: 30/07 (Sunday)
Wind: South to southeast force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier over some areas at first. Hot with sunny intervals in the afternoon.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
